planets.name: K2-174 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-174 with a 19.6-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-174 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-174. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
